sources.title: FinOps Foundation: AI Cost Management Capability
sources.notes: Framework guidance for applying FinOps practices, showback/chargeback, and unit economics to AI workloads, now including agentic-era guidance (FinOps for AI working group).

sources.title: OpenTelemetry: GenAI Semantic Conventions
sources.notes: Standardized attribute and metric definitions for AI instrumentation including gen_ai.system, model, usage tokens, and errors. As of June 2026 (semantic-conventions v1.42.0) the GenAI conventions were deprecated out of the main repo and moved to the dedicated OpenTelemetry GenAI Semantic Conventions repository; still in Development status.

sources.title: OpenAI API Pricing and Token Limits
sources.notes: Official model pricing including GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6 Sol / 6.1 Sol / 6.1 Terra, GPT-6 Luna, GPT-5.x series, and prompt caching discounts.

sources.title: OpenAI: GPT-6 Sol & Luna and GPT-6 Astra Release Notes
sources.notes: Announcements of the GPT-6 generation: Astra flagship, Sol, Luna, and 6.1 Terra, including 50% price cuts on Sept 22 2026, half-price 6.1 tiers (Oct 2026), and up to 90% prompt-cache hit discounts by default.

sources.title: Anthropic Claude Pricing and Prompt Caching
sources.notes: Official Claude pricing including Fable 5.2 and 5.1, Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Haiku 5.5, and their prompt-cache read discount terms (cache reads halved on Sonnet 5.5; Fable 5.2 cache reads at 97.5% off input).

sources.title: Google AI for Developers: Gemini API Pricing
sources.notes: Official Gemini API pricing tiers including Gemini 4 Hydrogen/Argon/Carbon and Gemini 3.x Flash models, with implicit context caching and scheduled rate increases.

sources.title: Amazon Web Services: Amazon Bedrock Pricing
sources.notes: Official managed-model pricing for Bedrock on-demand invocations and Provisioned Throughput hourly commitments.

sources.title: Google Cloud: Model Garden & Vertex AI Pricing
sources.notes: Enterprise Agent Platform and Vertex AI serving options, regional rates, and commitment options (e.g. Agent Platform introductory $0.75/$3.75 per 1M in/out through Dec 31 2026).

sources.title: Microsoft Azure: Azure OpenAI Service Pricing
sources.notes: Standard pay-as-you-go rates (e.g. GPT-6.1 series at $5.50 input / $0.55 cached / $33 output per 1M) and Provisioned Throughput Units (PTU) reserved capacity for enterprise OpenAI models.

sources.title: Artificial Analysis: Independent LLM Benchmarks & Quality/Price Frontier
sources.notes: Independent benchmarking of model quality indices, median Time To First Token (TTFT), generation tokens per second (TPS), and price efficiency.

sources.title: vLLM: High-Throughput and Memory-Efficient Inference Engine
sources.notes: Open-source serving architecture, PagedAttention KV-cache management, continuous batching, and self-hosted inference economics.

sources.title: FinOps Foundation: FOCUS™ Open Cost and Usage Specification
sources.notes: Open-standard cloud billing schema normalizing billing and usage across clouds and AI services. FOCUS 1.5 (2026) adds AI token-meter labels, a SKU/identity linkage, and the person/service-account/agent behind each cost row.

sources.title: LiteLLM: Enterprise AI Gateway & Routing Specification
sources.notes: Production proxy architecture for centralized rate limits, fallbacks, OTel telemetry, and multi-provider load balancing.
